question: Global Flexible Packaging New Zealand
markdown:
Global flexible packaging in New Zealand features international giants Amcor and Huhtamaki alongside local specialists Convex, Allflex Packaging, and Hi-Tech Packaging. These companies offer sustainable, high-performance, and recyclable packaging options, with trends focusing on recyclable mono-materials, advanced printing, and food-safe barrier films.
Global flexible packaging in New Zealand involves major international operators like Amcor PLC and Huhtamaki, alongside strong local specialists such as Convex, Allflex Packaging, and Hi-Tech Packaging.
Convex is known for award-winning eco-friendly flexible packaging, modified atmosphere films for fresh produce, and compostable innovations.
Allflex Packaging is an Auckland-based, NZ-owned provider specializing in custom printed bags, stand-up pouches, and flexible films.
Hi-Tech Packaging focuses on global sourcing, international quality standards (BRCGS, HACCP), and tailored sustainable flexible packaging.
Amcor and Huhtamaki supply large-scale mono-material, recyclable, and fiber-based packaging solutions to the wider Australasian market.
Main trends include a shift toward recyclable mono-materials and ocean-bound plastics, high-definition flexographic and digital printing for retail and food branding, and certified food-safe barrier films designed to extend shelf life.
